purpose.zh: 拉开身子侧面，久坐腰背发紧时松一松
purpose.en: Stretches the side of your body to ease a tight back from sitting.

text.zh: 一只手臂举高，身子往另一边慢慢弯
text.en: Raise one arm and slowly bend toward the other side

text.zh: 屁股坐稳，两脚踩地，另一只手臂放松垂着。
text.en: Butt stays seated, feet flat, other arm relaxed by your side.

text.zh: 两边屁股都坐实椅面，弯的时候别抬起来。
text.en: Both sides of your butt stay on the chair. Don't lift one as you bend.

text.zh: 呼气时举高的手再往斜上方够远一点。
text.en: Each breath out, reach the raised hand a little further up and over.

commonErrors.en: One side of your butt lifting off the seat.

commonErrors.zh: 上身往前趴，不是往旁边弯
commonErrors.en: Leaning forward instead of bending to the side.

cautions.zh: 腰背或肩膀疼就弯小点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your back or shoulder hurts, don't bend as far. Stop if it still hurts.
